documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a revenue of Rs 472.2 crores for Q1 FY27, representing a 53.3% year-on-year increase compared to Q1 FY26. EBITDA for the quarter stood at Rs 92.3 crores with an EBITDA margin of 19.2%, while Profit After Tax (PAT) reached Rs 65.6 crores with a 13.6% margin. The company is undertaking an ongoing capex of approximately Rs 200 crores to expand its manufacturing capacity from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA, with commissioning targeted by September 2026. Management highlighted robust operational performance, strong internal cash generation, and a debt-free balance sheet. Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported its FY26 financial and operational performance, highlighting a capacity expansion initiative from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA.

guidance.claim: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity is expected by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

demand_outlook.claim: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.
demand_outlook.quote: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to their high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.

demand_outlook.claim: EV adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics.
demand_outlook.quote: EV (Electric Vehicle) adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics for interior trims and battery housings.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market is shifting toward specialty and colored grades away from commoditized transparent resins.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market is shifting toward specialty & colored grades, moving away from commoditized transparent resins to higher-margin applications.

demand_outlook.claim: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables and automotive will drive domestic demand for ABS.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables (air conditioners, refrigerators) and automotive will drive the domestic demand for ABS.

demand_outlook.claim: The IMF trimmed its world GDP forecast to 2.9% in April.
demand_outlook.quote: The IMF trimmed its 2026 world GDP forecast to 2.9% in April, but a recession is not the base case.

demand_outlook.claim: FY27 consensus GDP growth is estimated at 6.8% to 7.0%.
demand_outlook.quote: FY27 consensus is 6.8% - 7.0%, assuming oil stabilization and a normal monsoon.

demand_outlook.claim: India's real annual GDP growth for FY 2025-26 is 7.6%.
demand_outlook.quote: As per the Press Information Bureau, the real annual GDP growth for FY 2025-26 is 7.6%, higher than the 7.1% recorded in FY 2024-25, while nominal GDP, measured at current prices, is projected to grow by 8.6% during FY 2025-26.

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion from 75,000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well.
capex_expansion.quote: The implementation of capacity expansion from existing 75000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well and orders have been placed for critical long delivery equipments.

capex_expansion.claim: Commissioning of the enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by the end of September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations increased by 53.3% year-on-year in Q1 FY27 to Rs 472.2 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue from operations increased by +53.3% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 472.2 crores, from ₹ 307.9 crores in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 44.5% year-on-year in Q1 FY27 to Rs 92.3 crores with margins at 19.2%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores, from ₹ 63.9 crores in Q1 FY26, with margins at 19.2% for Q1 FY27 as compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores with margins at 21.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores, with margins at 21.8%; for FY26, EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores, with margins at 20.0%.

margins_costs.claim: The operating margin for FY 2025-26 was 19.42%.
margins_costs.quote: The operating margin for FY 2025-26 was 19.42 % as compared to 17.43 % for FY 2024-25, whereas the net profit margin stood at 14.14 % as compared to 12.86 % for the previous FY.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates two manufacturing facilities at Abu Road and Satnoor.
orders_capacity.quote: Operates two manufacturing facilities at Abu Road (Rajasthan) and Satnoor (Madhya Pradesh), supported by an in-house R&D centre at Abu Road.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved a production volume of 71,601.50 TPA against an installed capacity of 75,000 TPA during FY 2025-26.
orders_capacity.quote: During FY 2025-26, the Company achieved a production volume of 71,601.50 TPA against installed capacity of 75,000 TPA.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume for FY 2025-26 stood at 71,501.12 TPA.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume for the year stood at 71,501.12 TPA as compared to 74,381 TPA in FY 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a gross debt to equity ratio of 0.0x with a debt-free balance sheet.
The company continues to enjoy the status of a zero debt company.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company continues to enjoy the status of a “Zero Debt Company”.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a final dividend of Re. 1 per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The Directors have recommended a Final Dividend of `1/- (100 %) per Equity Share (of face value of `1/- each) for the financial year ended 31st March, 2026 which is subject to approval of the shareholders of the Company in the ensuing 42nd Annual General Meeting.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Iran conflict entered its fourth month.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Iran conflict has now entered its fourth month, and the global economy is adapting rather than collapsing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Oil importers have borne the brunt of the shock.
risks_headwinds.quote: Oil importers — India, Japan, South Korea, much of Europe — have borne the brunt of the shock.

management_commitments.claim: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity is expected by the end of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Commissioning of the enhanced capacity to 1,00,000 TPA is expected to be completed by the end of September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
